rule: Select one primary packet. Actual proof dependencies and status require original evidence; upstream lists are advisory. Review nominees recuse if contributors.

assignments.target_statement: Derive exact or rigorous asymptotic spectra for selected threshold, tribes, and threshold-composition controls. Use them to discriminate among candidate universal payments.

deliverables.description: STRUCTURED_CONTROLS.tex: exact spectra or rigorous asymptotics for threshold/tribes/composition families
CONTROL_DISCRIMINATION.json: candidate cost versus actual influence

acceptance_criteria: Give exact multiplicities or a proved asymptotic formula with remainder for each named control family.
Separate biased balancing parameters from the uniform original-input law and include all variables in influence.
Evaluate the current candidate's unpaid term on the controls; merely rechecking the already proved all-threshold theorem is not a new result.
assignments.renewal_milestone: One reusable structured-control ledger separates two live candidate payments or exposes a missing term.

assignments.target_statement: Construct increasingly rare Boolean defects inside tensor or selector towers. Track the entropy and influence contribution of each scale separately to expose repeated use of the same budget.

deliverables.description: SPARSE_DEFECT_TOWERS.tex: actual Boolean construction at every scale
MULTISCALE_COST_LEDGER.json: entropy, influence, and credited resource by level

acceptance_criteria: Specify the full Boolean circuit/recursion with distinct physical coordinates and any declared reuse.
Compute cross-scale interference and track the probability-weighted cost of every defect; additivity cannot be assumed for overlapping changes.
Prove whether one candidate influence or information credit is reused across scales, and distinguish a local surcharge divergence from H/I divergence.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A new multiscale obstruction or a complete compensated tower calculation justifies extending the construction.

assignments.target_statement: Build actual Boolean parity-code and auxiliary-padding constructions. Track added influence as well as preserved entropy; a formal spectral-law construction is insufficient.

deliverables.description: PADDING_ENERGY.md: entropy retained, influence added, and derivative/cap checks

acceptance_criteria: Give actual Boolean inverse Walsh signs or a truth-table/circuit realization; an admissible abstract subset law is not enough.
Import the existing independent-padding energy/cap barrier and include every auxiliary influence cost.
State whether the construction uses independent product padding, deterministic occupied coordinates, or genuinely new dependence, and prove the exact scope of every hierarchy condition used.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A new genuine Boolean realization with quantified energy, or a complete impossibility barrier for the proposed code.

assignments.target_statement: Seek genuine Boolean realizations with correlated auxiliary spectra that evade independent-padding bounds. Retain the conditional auxiliary entropy and quantify the energy required by phase realization.

deliverables.description: CORRELATED_AUXILIARY_CONSTRUCTION.tex: actual Boolean f(X,Y) and spectral dependence
CONDITIONAL_ENERGY_LEDGER.md: H(S_Y|S_X), auxiliary influence, and degree

acceptance_criteria: Keep the physical cube uniform with disjoint X,Y; only the spectral auxiliaries are allowed to be correlated under the existing phase-energy baseline.
Verify the full Boolean realization and retain conditional auxiliary entropy rather than counting only a marginal law.
Quantify why the construction differs from independent padding and test whether its proposed entropy completion hides arbitrary tensor factors.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A genuinely correlated Boolean construction with a new paid conditional regime, or a proved energy lower bound excluding it.

assignments.target_statement: For any candidate FEI disproof, prove a sequence of actual Boolean functions with H/I unbounded. Check that the growth survives every normalization; a finite ratio above a proposed constant is only a constant lower bound.

deliverables.description: FEI_DISPROOF_STANDARD.md: exact universal target and all normalization checks
CANDIDATE_SEQUENCE_AUDIT.tex: actual functions and proved H/I limit

acceptance_criteria: Require actual Boolean f_m for an unbounded sequence of dimensions and prove H(f_m)/I(f_m)→∞.
Do not substitute B/I, Δ_selH/I_sel, witness residual/I, or a raw surrogate for the actual FEI ratio.
Check every mean, sign, logarithm, added variable, and limiting regime; a finite ratio above one constant is reported only as a constant lower bound.
The recovered point defect is a Rényi obstruction with Shannon H/I→4; it is an explicit control against confusing surrogate divergence with an FEI disproof.
assignments.renewal_milestone: Trigger only for a credible disproof candidate; otherwise freeze this acceptance standard and redeploy rather than invent a universal counterexample.
